entries.1334cdfcf1d0a889: NEXON Co., Ltd. serves as a business holding company responsible for game distribution in Japan and for the management of affiliated companies. The group consists of the company, 36 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]], and 13 affiliates and joint ventures accounted for under the equity method (as of December 31, 2025). Development is handled by NEXON Korea Corporation in South Korea and its subsidiary development companies, and in each region, local subsidiaries conduct business as independent management units.

entries.339c6b08bae35d73: Users basically start games for free and pay when they buy paid items such as costumes and weapons (item-based billing model). In China, because regulations prevent foreign-capital companies from distributing directly, distribution companies carry out distribution. The customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was Tencent Holdings Limited and one of its subsidiaries, at ¥94,133 million (19.8%) (¥143,300 million in the previous year).
entries.36253acd94fa7713: Building on live operations (operating a game while continuing to update it after release), it is carrying out an organizational restructuring in line with its IP growth strategy. The strategy has two directions: vertically, revitalizing and expanding major hit franchises such as Dungeon&Fighter and MapleStory across new content, platforms and regions; and horizontally, creating new major hits from other franchises such as Mabinogi and from new titles in development. In the vertical direction, it cites “hyper-localization,” which means changing content to suit players' preferences in each region, as an important element.

It also forms business alliances with domestic peers and others, and plays a role in expanding games developed by other domestic companies to markets in various countries through the group. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,509 million (a 10.0% decrease from the previous year).

entries.733e2ffab71139b6: It provides PC online games such as MapleStory, Dungeon&Fighter and FC ONLINE, and mobile games. It operates through three models: the “in-house distribution model,” in which it distributes games developed by the group itself; the “licensing model,” in which it grants distribution rights to distribution companies outside the group; and the “licensed distribution model,” in which it obtains distribution rights to games developed by other companies and distributes them.

entries.84bc66295ba3d920: This segment covers consulting services (business strategy, game operations and marketing) and infrastructure provided by the consolidated subsidiary Lexian Software Development (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. to game distribution companies in China. Under Chinese regulatory restrictions, companies with foreign capital cannot directly distribute PC online games, so this structure is used. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,774 million (a 32.3% decrease from the previous year).

entries.8f65739fa60f8a1e: This segment covers the development and distribution of PC online games and mobile games by the Korean consolidated subsidiary NEXON Korea Corporation and its subsidiaries NEOPLE INC., NEXON Games Co., Ltd. and others. The intellectual property (IP) of “MapleStory” is held by NEXON Korea Corporation, and that of “Arad Senki” by NEOPLE INC.; each grants exclusive distribution rights for individual games to distribution companies outside the group and receives royalties. Revenue of this segment includes royalty revenue from licensing by NEOPLE INC. in China. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥400,657 million (a 3.0% decrease from the previous year).
entries.950f92eee8fd229d: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥92,052 million (down 31.7% from the previous year, when it was ¥134,848 million). entries.ee1eea00ad70927a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥475,102 million (up 6.5% from the previous year), a record high. By business, PC online revenue was ¥335,313 million and mobile revenue was ¥136,245 million. It explains that, in addition to the revitalization of the PC versions of Dungeon&Fighter and MapleStory, the titles it began distributing within the year, namely Mabinogi Mobile, ARC Raiders and MapleStory: Idle RPG, contributed to higher revenue. By customer location, revenue was ¥249,973 million for South Korea, ¥109,513 million for China, and ¥68,582 million for North America and Europe.
